cli.intro: OpenIDA — inspect binary headers, sections, imports, exports, symbols, strings, bytes and patches.

cmd.capabilities: Print what this build supports, honestly
cmd.info: Open a binary and print its format, architecture, entry point and hash
cmd.sections: Print the section table with addresses, file offsets and access flags
cmd.imports: Print imported functions with their modules and import-slot addresses
cmd.exports: Print exported symbols with ordinals, addresses and forwarders
cmd.symbols: Print debug or dynamic symbols with kind, binding and section
cmd.debug: Print PE debug directory entries and CodeView PDB records
cmd.version: Print the PE version resource (file/product version and string table)
cmd.macho: Print Mach-O load commands, segments, sections, dylibs and image identity
cmd.mitigations: Print the PE mitigation posture (ASLR, DEP, CFG, GS, W+X, relocations)
cmd.resources: Print the PE resource directory (type, name, language, size)
cmd.relocations: Print the PE base relocation blocks and their fixup types
cmd.exception: Print the PE exception directory runtime functions and unwind headers
cmd.peDelayImports: Print the PE delay-import descriptors and their INT/IAT thunks
cmd.peBoundImports: Print the PE bound-import descriptors and their forwarder refs
cmd.peRichHeader: Print the PE Rich header build stamp and its entries
cmd.elfSymbols: Print the ELF static symbol table (.symtab) entries
cmd.dynamic: Print ELF dynamic dependencies: interpreter, SONAME, NEEDED, RPATH and RUNPATH
cmd.segments: Print the ELF program header table with permissions and load ranges
cmd.notes: Print ELF notes: build id, GNU ABI tag and GNU properties
cmd.certificates: Print the PE attribute certificate table entries (headers only, never verified)
cmd.tls: Print the PE TLS directory and its callback array
cmd.load-config: Print the PE load configuration, guard flags and security cookie
cmd.code-signature: Print the Mach-O embedded code signature and CodeDirectory (never verified)
cmd.machoSymbols: Print the Mach-O LC_SYMTAB symbol table with kinds and sections
cmd.machoFunctionStarts: Print the Mach-O LC_FUNCTION_STARTS function addresses
cmd.machoExports: Print the Mach-O dyld export trie symbols and flags
cmd.machoEncryption: Print the Mach-O LC_ENCRYPTION_INFO offset, size and cryptid
cmd.machoChainedFixups: Print the Mach-O LC_DYLD_CHAINED_FIXUPS imports and starts
cmd.machoBindings: Print the Mach-O LC_DYLD_INFO bind, weak-bind and lazy-bind opcodes
cmd.machoSlices: Print the architecture slices of a fat/universal Mach-O container
cmd.machoExtract: Write one fat/universal Mach-O slice to a new file
cmd.disasm: Disassemble x86 / x64 instructions or CPython bytecode from a file offset
cmd.diff: Compare two binaries byte for byte and list differing ranges
cmd.entropy: Print whole-file and per-section entropy plus the PE overlay
cmd.overlay: Print the PE overlay anatomy and its embedded container signatures
cmd.inflate: Decode one embedded zlib, gzip or raw DEFLATE stream, optionally writing it out
cmd.nsis: Decode one NSIS installer container, optionally extracting its payload files
cmd.asar: Decode one Electron asar archive, optionally extracting its packed entries
cmd.search: Search for hex bytes, ASCII text or UTF-16LE text
cmd.find: Search the whole file with a byte regex and preview every match
cmd.dump: Export a raw byte range from the file to a new file
cmd.carve: Carve the printable regions around a byte-regex marker, optionally writing them out
cmd.tauriAssets: Extract the embedded assets of a Tauri v2 executable, optionally writing them out
cmd.offset: Map a file offset onto an RVA and a virtual address
cmd.strings: Extract printable ASCII or UTF-16LE runs with their file offsets
cmd.hexdump: Print a canonical hex dump of one byte range
cmd.rva: Map an RVA or virtual address onto a file offset
cmd.patch: Write bytes atomically and report the before/after hashes

opt.limit: Maximum number of results to return (default 100 for strings and search)
opt.skip: Number of leading hits to drop before the limit (default 0)
opt.all: Return every hit up to the engine hard cap of 2,000,000 (ignores --limit)
opt.encoding: String encoding: ascii, utf16le or both (default ascii)
opt.mode: Pattern kind: hex, ascii or utf16le (default ascii)
opt.case: Require ASCII letters to match case
opt.word: Only match patterns surrounded by non-word characters
opt.pattern: Regular expression evaluated against the raw bytes (required for find)
opt.context: Bytes rendered into each match preview (default 80, capped at 512)
opt.output: Destination file for the exported bytes
opt.marker: Byte regex that marks the regions to carve (required for carve)
opt.carveMax: Right expansion cap per region, in bytes (default 262144)
opt.expandLeft: Left expansion cap per region, in bytes (default 4096)
opt.carveOut: Directory the carved regions are written to as carve_<n>.bin
opt.tauriOut: Directory the decoded Tauri assets are written to, mirroring their key paths
opt.tauriLimit: Maximum number of Tauri assets to return (default 200, capped at 1000)
opt.inflateOffset: File offset of the first compressed byte (default 0)
opt.inflateFormat: Wrapper to expect: auto, zlib, gzip or raw (default auto)
opt.inflateLimit: Maximum decoded bytes to produce (default 4 MiB, capped at 64 MiB)
opt.inflateOut: Destination file for the decoded bytes; omit to only report the head
opt.nsisOffset: Absolute offset of the NSIS first header (default: scan the file)
opt.nsisCommandsLimit: Maximum rendered script commands (default 4096, capped at 65536)
opt.nsisExtractDir: Directory the NSIS payload files are extracted into
opt.nsisExtractLimit: Maximum bytes per extracted file (default 256 MiB, capped at 1 GiB)
opt.asarOffset: Absolute offset of the asar archive start (default 0)
opt.asarEntriesLimit: Maximum listed file entries (default 4096, capped at 65536)
opt.asarExtractDir: Directory the asar packed entries are extracted into
opt.asarExtractLimit: Maximum bytes per extracted entry (default 256 MiB, capped at 1 GiB)
opt.disasmFormat: Decoding path: auto, x86 or pyc (default auto)
opt.disasmCode: Keep only code objects whose qualname or name contains this text (pyc only)
opt.disasmCodeLimit: Maximum decoded code objects (default 1024, capped at 16384; pyc only)
opt.disasmInstructionLimit: Maximum emitted bytecode instructions (default 65536, capped at 1048576; pyc only)
opt.end: One past the last file offset to scan
opt.offset: File offset to inspect, decimal or 0x-prefixed
opt.count: Maximum number of instructions to decode (default 64, capped at 4096)
opt.extractOut: Destination file for the extracted slice; the source is never overwritten
opt.syntax: Assembly syntax: intel, masm or nasm (default intel)
opt.bytes: Hex bytes to write, such as 90,90 or 0x90 0x90
opt.out: Write the patched copy here instead of the source file

err.encoding: `--encoding` must be ascii, utf16le or both
